parsed.post: Kept shard expansion: 1.0983 -> 0.9430 with D4, batch 262144, mLR 0.08, no warmup. Data lever dominated. Next I'll test capacity with DEPTH=8, keeping batch and LR fixed, to see if the 5-minute budget still supports the larger model. Flag: train_shards 0-10 overlaps eval shard 10.
parsed.description: Increase depth to 8 with all available training shards to test capacity gain after data expansion.
